map.💡 轴功率 = Q × Δp / (3600 × η × 1000) kW，η=: 💡 Shaft power = Q × Δp / (3600 × η × 1000) kW, η=0.8; motor power = shaft power × 1.15 (safety margin); specific speed ns = 5.54 × n × √Q / Δp^(3/4) (Q: m³/s, Δp: Pa; centrifugal 15~80, mixed-flow 80~120, axial 100~500).

map.算法：轴功率 P = 风量×风压/(3600×效率×1000)（kW，效率取 0: Algorithm: shaft power P = airflow × pressure / (3600 × efficiency × 1000) (kW, efficiency 0.8);
map.= 轴功率×1.15；额定功率向上取到 0.5 的倍数；比转速 ns = 5.5: motor power = shaft power × 1.15; rated power rounds up to a multiple of 0.5; specific speed ns = 5.54 × speed × √Qs / total-pressure^0.75 (Qs = airflow/3600, m³/s; total pressure in Pa). Recommended type by ns band: <15 centrifugal (forward-curved), 15~30 centrifugal (forward), 30~50 centrifugal (radial), 50~80 centrifugal (backward), 80~120 mixed-flow, ≥120 axial; impeller diameter by tip speed u = πDn/60.
map.例：风量 10000m³/h、风压 1000Pa、转速 1450rpm → 轴功: Example: airflow 10000 m³/h, pressure 1000 Pa, speed 1450 rpm → shaft 3.47 kW, motor 3.99 kW, rated 4 kW, specific speed 75.3 (centrifugal · backward-curved), a medium-power fan. If airflow 30000, pressure 2000 → shaft 20.83 kW, motor 23.96 kW, rated 24 kW, specific speed 77.5 (centrifugal · backward-curved), a large fan.
map.综合流量与压力的相似准则数，决定叶轮型式：比转速由小到大依次为离心（前向/径向/: A similarity criterion combining flow and pressure that determines impeller type: from low to high ns the order is centrifugal (forward / radial / backward), mixed-flow, axial; same-series fans share close ns, and selection should place the duty ns in the high-efficiency zone.
map.为机械传动与过载裕量示例值；含变频、长管路或工况波动大时应取更大，并校核启动转矩: It is an example value for mechanical transmission and overload margin; with VFD, long ducts, or large duty swings use a larger factor and check starting torque.
